name: EnerSyn Global Inc.
summary: EnerSyn Global Inc., formerly HWH International Inc., is a lifestyle and consumer-focused company operating businesses in Singapore and South Korea, including Hapi Café, Hapi Marketplace, and Hapi Wealth Builder. Hapi Café offers health-focused dining options, while Hapi Marketplace operates an online business-to-consumer marketplace offering a range of products. Hapi Wealth Builder provides educational programs, courses, workshops, and coaching focused on investment and wealth-building strategies. The company is also expanding its planned operations into energy-related areas, including oil and gas resources, natural gas processing, coal-based energy production, strategic minerals, and the integration and digitalization of energy assets.
